subject: EU staging carveout request — OptiHealth load test
messages:
From: Ryan Chen <ryan@optihealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: Staging carveout request for Friday load test

Hi Mina,

Quick ask from our infra/QA team: we have a scheduled synthetic load test against the EU staging environment on Friday (11/26) to validate the new batching and KV-cache changes. To get stable signals we need a short, reserved slice of dedicated capacity in eu-west for a 48-hour window (Friday 08:00–Saturday 08:00 UTC).

Estimate: ~8 A100-equivalent GPUs for the peak run (total ~90 GPU-hours). The test drives long sequences and we expect autoscale to spin up extra workers — we'd prefer those to come from a reserved carveout rather than the preemptible pool to avoid test noise.

I've attached a short scope doc with traffic profiles and timing (optitest_scope.pdf). Can Redwood provision this? If there are approval steps or SSO access requirements we can start that today.

Thanks,
Ryan Chen
Head of SRE, OptiHealth
ryan@optihealth.com

Subject: Re: Staging carveout request for Friday load test

Team — forwarding OptiHealth's ask. TL;DR: 8 A100s, 48h block (Fri 08:00–Sat 08:00 UTC), prefer reserved slice to avoid interference from preemptible bursting.

Questions for ops/procurement:
- Kimberly / Jonas: possible to provision a temporary reservation in eu-west for that window? If we can't hand out a fully reserved pool, can we guarantee non-preemptible capacity (i.e., reserved with preemption disabled) for the run?
- Laura: any billing/contract signoff needed for a short carveout like this (they're a current pilot customer; small one-off charge ok)? If so, who signs?
- Stephanie: will this bump any other pilots in the same window?

If we can enable with a short runbook and explicit preemption fallback (e.g., route to a smaller model variant when capacity dips), I'm ok to green-light. I attached a draft runbook for discussion (carveout_runbook_draft.md).

Goal: confirm by EOD today so Ryan can finish DocuSign access.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior Manager, Customer Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Staging carveout request for Friday load test

Mina — we can do a temporary carveout but we need to be explicit about two constraints:

1) Capacity topology: eu-west currently has a maintenance window on Thurs evening that reduces free headroom. I can carve out 6 non-preemptible A100-equivalents guaranteed, and allow up to +2 burst slots on preemptible workers as overflow. If OptiHealth insists on all 8 non-preemptible, we need an SLA exception and a short approval from infra, which will take ~3 hours to process.

2) Autoscale policy: we'll need a short-lived autoscale exception that disables aggressive scale-down for the window (so we don't oscillate during the test). That requires a patch to the autoscale policy and an Ops runbook to revert it. Jonas, can your team prepare a revert playbook?

If they confirm the 6+2 model we can approve today.

Kimberly
Head of Dedicated Capacity Operations
Redwood Inference

> Mina — we can do a temporary carveout but we need to be explicit about two constraints:
> 
> 1) Capacity topology...

Confirmed — ops can prepare the revertable changes. Proposed runbook (high level):
- 24h prior: reserve 6 non-preemptible units in eu-west, tag them OPTIHEALTH-EU-20261126.
- 6h prior: enable autoscale-exception flag for the tag to allow +2 burst on preemptible when utilization >85%.
- During run: monitor token-level latency and queue depth; if utilization >95% for >10m, switch traffic to a smaller model variant automatically (fallback route).
- Post-run: automatically drain and decommission the slice, verify no orphaned allocations, revert autoscale flags.

I've opened a Jira ticket SUP-2347 to track the exception changes and added the drive runbook folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1EU-stage-runbooks

Ops will also push a lightweight alert to oncall that triggers if preemption >5% during the window.

Jonas
Senior SRE, Dedicated Runtime
Redwood Inference
